messages:
Alex P: kicking off a short sync — we need to finalize prioritization for the enterprise compliance epic (audit logs + BYOK/KMS + retention tiers) before the planning doc deadline. TL;DR: customers expect exportable SOC2 evidence, tenant-level retention controls, and an opt-in BYOK handshake. Thoughts?
Priya S: +1. critical to map launch criteria to auditable evidence for SOC2. we should define Minimal Acceptable Evidence (MAE) for v1: immutable per-token audit entry, user id mapping, and export bundle format. :thumbsup:
Jordan O: ops note — export SLA expectation? some sales asks say "48h export SLA" which is unrealistic for large tenants. propose staged: (1) immediate streaming exports up to 100GB/day, (2) queued bulk exports for larger requests with ETA & progress.
Marisol E: engineering rough ballpark: v1 streaming + small queued exporter ~3 sprint dev (2 engs). full multi-tenant cold-archive + search index is another 4–6 sprints. major risk is retention enforcement at the routing layer.
Sam L: legal asks: retention exceptions for legal-hold must override tenant TTLs and be observable in export. need audit trail for hold events plus who authorized. also check cross-region data residency before rolling out export format.
Alex P: thanks. for BYOK: customer expectation = ability to bring keys, but some want KMS escrow/hand-off for e-discovery. do we commit to full BYOK handshake or a phased plan?
Priya S: recommend phased: BYOK v1 = per-tenant CMK integration (no escrow) + kms-usage audit events. BYOK v2 = key-escrow flow & support for HSM export process. v1 covers 80% of customers now.
Jordan O: operational SLA for keystore ops: key rotation + handshake telemetry must surface in console. propose these metrics: handshake_success_rate, rotation_lag_ms, last_rotation_actor.
Marisol E: technical note: supporting per-tenant retention needs changes upstream in routing and the prefix KV cache — we must propagate retention TTL in the request token metadata to avoid stale cache leaks. small patch but needs careful e2e tests.
Alex P: good call. let's make clear launch criteria for product decision: 1) MAE export bundle defined + sample export generated, 2) streaming export + queued exporter implemented with documented SLAs, 3) BYOK v1 integrated and audited, 4) legal-hold override & observable audit trail, 5) internal e2e test for cross-region residency. if any of these are partial, label release as "pilot / limited customers".
Priya S: add acceptance tests: sample SOC2 evidence runbook (how to get bundle, verify chain), and a regression check that audit ingestion latency < 2s for streaming path.
Sam L: also require a legal-fit checklist for regions (EU/UK APAC). flag any customers needing local-keystore-only.
Jordan O: operational runbook items: export cost estimate calc (per-GB), retention billing flag, incident playbook for failed exports, and throttling policy.
Marisol E: for roadmap phasing: sprint A (streaming + BYOK v1 + MAE export prototype), sprint B (queued bulk exporter + retention API + e2e residency tests), sprint C (indexing for search + long-term cold archive + BYOK v2 escrow).
Alex P: prioritization ask to exec: do we want to target GA (open to all customers) after sprint B, or keep GA after sprint C? leaning toward GA after B with guardrails.
Priya S: lean GA after B as well, provided legal region gating is enforced and we ship SOC2 evidence runbook. otherwise pilot only.
Sam L: agree — GA after B only if legal-runbook cleared. otherwise invite-only pilot.
Jordan O: one more tradeoff: indexing (searchable audit) adds cost and increases PII footprint in real-time index; if we keep index optional per-tenant we reduce risk. propose index opt-in for GA.
Marisol E: opt-in index makes sense. implement flags in retention API and in console. dev effort +1 sprint for index gating.
Alex P: action items: 1) Marisol to draft tech scope & estimate for sprint A/B by EOD Tue, 2) Priya to draft MAE & SOC2 runbook sample, 3) Jordan to draft ops SLA + export cost model, 4) Sam to create legal-region checklist and escalate any redlines. i'll consolidate and push to planning doc.
Marisol E: got it — will add the retention-key propagation details and a small example snippet to show request header:
```
POST /v1/audit/append
Headers: {
  Authorization: Bearer <token>,
  X-Tenant-Retention: "3650d", // tenant TTL in days
  X-Tenant-Key-Id: "projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/r1/cryptoKeys/k1"
}
Body: { event: ... }
```
Jordan O: nice. also add exporter example CLI: `redwood export-evidence --tenant t-123 --since 2023-01-01 --format tar.gz --stream`
Priya S: minor ask: surface key fingerprint in export bundle metadata so auditors can match key used to encrypt evidence.
Alex P: noted. final question for this thread — any customer that blocks GA if we do GA after B? (call out large customers).
Sam L: @sales callouts: FinServPilot wants BYOK escrow and 7y retention. they'd be in pilot tranche unless BYOK v2 delivered.
Alex P: thanks. i'll tag in PM doc and put pilot gating table. closing thread — will post the consolidated spec tomorrow. :eyes:
